title: 第11章 狩土司第12章 邪祟游魂
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
午后阳光正好，仅一墙之隔的南外城，喧嚣远胜内城，尽显人间烟火。
贩夫走卒沿街叫卖，乞丐蜷缩在街角，三五成群的行人手持各式武器匆匆来往，酒肆茶楼吆喝声此起彼伏。
“少爷，”
一旁的钟宇低声解说：“因是新城初建，外城倒不算脏污狼藉，只是建筑普遍比内城低矮，街道也显得狭窄些。
最显着的不同，便是‘乱’。”
“乱？”
沈算目光扫过略显拥挤的街道。
“正是。
外城是众多狩猎团与帮派的盘踞之地，终日争夺地盘、收取保护费，底层百姓生活困苦，朝不保夕。”
钟宇语气带着一丝无奈。
“城主府不管？”
沈算皱眉。
“难管。”
钟宇摇头说：“外城势力盘根错节，城主府目前只能勉强维持一种脆弱的平衡。”
“要想彻底肃清，需要压倒性的实力。”
“因此在城主积蓄足够力量前，外城的秩序很难有根本性的改变。”
“说白了就是弱肉强食，安全得靠拳头打出来。”
负责护卫和背包的钟源直白地总结道。
此行只有他们三人步行。
原因倒也简单：南外城紧邻落霞山脉，仅十里缓冲之地。

十里之外，便是危机四伏的起伏山林。
进山之人，要么步行，要么有灵兽代步——总不能让沈算骑着幼犬阿泰进山吧。
外城虽有马车行租售马匹和马车供游人出城游玩，但他们此行并非游玩，而是要去“西山乱坟岗”
这种地方“办事”
夜间进山的马匹，多半有去无回。
至于人能否回来，则全凭实力与运气了。
说白了就是没钱！
正行走间，一股浓郁的血腥味混在风里传来，紧接着是急促的呼喊：“快让开！
让开……！”
街道上顿时一阵骚动。
content_en:
The afternoon sun was just right, and the South Outer City, which was only separated by a wall, was far more noisy than the inner city, showing off all the fireworks in the world.
Vendors and goons were hawking along the street, beggars were huddled on the street corners, small groups of pedestrians holding various weapons hurriedly came and went, and shouts and shouts from wine shops and teahouses could be heard one after another.
"Master,"
Zhong Yu on the side explained in a low voice: "Because it was the first time the new city was built, the outer city is not dirty and messy, but the buildings are generally lower than the inner city and the streets are narrower.
The most obvious difference is ‘chaos’. "
"Chaos?"
Shen Suan glanced at the slightly crowded streets.
"Exactly.
The outer city is home to many hunting groups and gangs. They compete for territory and collect protection fees all day long. The people at the bottom live in poverty and precariously. "
Zhong Yu's tone was filled with helplessness.
"The city lord's palace doesn't care?"
Shen Suan frowned.
"Hard to manage."
Zhong Yu shook his head and said: "The forces in the outer city are intertwined, and the city lord's palace can only maintain a fragile balance at present."
"To completely eliminate it, overwhelming strength is needed."
"Therefore, until the city lord accumulates enough strength, it will be difficult to fundamentally change the order of the outer city."
"To put it bluntly, it's the jungle of the jungle. Safety has to be achieved with fists."
Zhong Yuan, who was responsible for the escort and backpack, summed it up straightforwardly.
Only the three of them walked on this trip.
The reason is simple: South Outer City is close to the Luoxia Mountains, with only a ten-mile buffer.
Ten miles away, there are undulating mountains and forests full of dangers.
Those who enter the mountain must either walk or be transported by a spirit animal - Shen Suan cannot be allowed to ride his puppy Atai into the mountain.
Although there are carriage shops in the outer city that rent and sell horses and carriages for tourists to travel out of the city, their trip is not for fun, but to go to the "Western Graveyard"
This kind of place "does business"
Most of the horses that enter the mountains at night never return.
As for whether a person can come back, it all depends on strength and luck.
To put it bluntly, there is no money!
While walking, a strong smell of blood mixed with the wind came, followed by a hurried cry: "Get out of the way!
Get out of the way...! "
There was a sudden commotion in the street.
